<ic>To accept the treaty between the people of the Druj and the people of the Empire.<br><br><i>Proposed by the Conscience of the Senate, Seconded by Zenith.</i></ic>
{{CaptionedImage|file=DrujTreaty.png|caption=The Druj treaty|align=right|width=300}}
===Overview===
* A delegation from the [[Druj]] negotiated a treaty.
* The treaty was presented to the Senate.

===Date===
* Defeated Summer 379YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* The terms of the treaty were not accepted.
* The Druj delegates were present during the discussion of the treaty and are aware it has been rejected.
